title: A Control-Driven Framework for Secure SaaS Onboarding in Regulated Enterprises
abstract: arXiv:2607.16543v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As enterprises increasingly adopt Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platforms for mission-critical functions, onboarding these services has emerged as a complex challenge extending well beyond procurement and basic security review. In regulated environments, SaaS onboarding must address multiple interdependent control domains, including Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), cybersecurity assessment, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and disaster recovery (DR), which are often executed in isolation, resulting in delayed go-lives, duplicated assessments, unclear ownership, and residual operational risk. This paper proposes a control-driven, end-to-end SaaS onboarding framework that integrates TPRM, cybersecurity, IAM, and DR into a unified lifecycle model. The framework introduces a stage-based approach spanning intake and risk scoping, architecture validation, identity design, resilience assessment, and post-production governance.

translated_title: 一种面向受监管企业中安全SaaS接入的控制驱动框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.16543v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：随着企业越来越多地采用软件即服务（SaaS）平台用于关键任务功能，接入这些服务已成为一项复杂的挑战，远远超出采购和基本安全审查的范畴。在受监管环境中，SaaS接入必须处理多个相互依赖的控制域，包括第三方风险管理（TPRM）、网络安全评估、身份与访问管理（IAM）和灾难恢复（DR），这些通常被孤立执行，导致上线延迟、评估重复、责任不清和残余运营风险。本文提出了一种控制驱动的端到端SaaS接入框架，将TPRM、网络安全、IAM和DR整合到一个统一的生命周期模型中。该框架引入了一种基于阶段的方法，涵盖接收与风险范围界定、架构验证、身份设计、韧性评估和后期生产治理。
tldr: 本文提出了一种控制驱动的端到端SaaS接入框架，通过整合TPRM、网络安全、IAM和DR到统一生命周期模型中，解决了受监管企业中SaaS接入的孤立执行和风险问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a control-driven, end-to-end SaaS onboarding framework that integrates TPRM, cybersecurity, IAM, and DR into a unified lifecycle model, addressing the fragmented execution and operational risks in regulated enterprises.
